races.display_title: Unibet Middle Distance Chase Series Veterans' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: None of these can be ruled out but TRIPLE TRADE scored in veterans company at Sandown last term and also made a winning return at Cheltenham last season so gets the nod from a yard well among the winners. Sure Touch has a very good record here and could emerge as the main danger, although the returning Ga Law is weighted to go well if ready to roll after 10 months off the track. TRIPLE TRADE SURE TOUCH GA LAW (FR)
races.betting_forecast: Triple Trade (2/1), Sure Touch (9/4), Tommy's Oscar (7/2), Ga Law (4/1), Mars Harper (20/1)

races.verdict: FOUNTAIN HOUSE is a tricky one to assess but is potentially thrown-in on the form of his cross-country wins at the Punchestown Festival and looks worth chancing switched back to a regulation chase. Luimneach arrives in top form and tanked through the race when winning at Gowran so rates the main threat despite a 9 lb rise, while Watch The Weather can usually be relied upon to give his running and is respected with Jack Kennedy returning to the saddle. FOUNTAIN HOUSE (IRE) LUIMNEACH (IRE) WATCH THE WEATHER

races.verdict: The market should prove highly informative but Emmet Mullins' Blue Bresil gelding NOON BLU DODVILLE is taken to make a winning start at the chief expense of Gavin Cromwell's Ten Sovereigns newcomer Ten Gears . races.verdict: LIRAKALI failed by the narrowest of margins on his recent hurdling debut at Gowran and is fancied to build on it and go one better here. Gordon Elliott's hurdling newcomer Soul Asylum brings a fair bit of potential from bumpers and rates the main danger, while Backinbusiness and Farney Bridge can fight it out for minor honours. races.verdict: LAND OF PUNT has joined a yard with a good record with recruits from other stables and, with his recent return likely to have brought him on, he looks worth chancing in a race where a little improvement may go a long way, with last year’s course winner Cathryns Ruby feared most after a consistent spell in handicaps and Chosen Shant respected given her 4 wins from 8 at Wexford. LAND OF PUNT (IRE) CATHRYNS RUBY (IRE) CHOSEN SHANT (IRE)
